# Texoma Lakeside RV Park

> Affordable long-term RV park in Cartwright, Oklahoma, located 1 mile from Burns Run West boat ramps on Lake Texoma.

## About

Texoma Lakeside RV Park is a family-owned RV community in Cartwright, Oklahoma (Bryan County) offering affordable long-term monthly RV site leases near Lake Texoma. The park features oversized 33x50 foot gravel pads with full hookups including water, sewer, and 20/30/50 amp electric service. Free WiFi and trash service are included in all rates.

## Location

- Address: 81 Willafa Woods Rd, Cartwright, OK 74731
- GPS Coordinates: 33.8567, -96.5342
- 1 mile from Burns Run West boat ramps (Lake Texoma)
- Less than 7 miles from US-75
- 20 minutes from Durant, Oklahoma (shopping, dining, medical)
- 15 miles from Choctaw Casino & Resort
- 90 minutes north of Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex

## Rates

- Monthly: $450/month + electric (best value for long-term living)
- Weekly: $175/week
- Daily: $30/night
- All rates include: water, sewer, WiFi, and trash service

## Amenities

- Oversized 33x50 foot gravel pads
- Full hookups: water, sewer, electric (20/30/50 amp)
- Free WiFi
- Onsite trash service
- Shade trees
- Playground
- Pet friendly
- 24/7 access
- Quiet, peaceful setting

## Lake Texoma Fishing & Boating

Lake Texoma is one of the top fishing destinations in the United States, straddling the Texas-Oklahoma border. The lake is renowned for:
- World-class striped bass (striper) fishing
- Largemouth bass
- Smallmouth bass
- Blue and channel catfish
- Crappie
- White bass

Burns Run West boat ramps are located just 1 mile from the park, providing quick access to some of the lake's best fishing spots on the Oklahoma side.

## Ideal For

- Full-time RV living (long-term monthly leases)
- Retirees seeking affordable lakeside living
- Remote workers wanting a peaceful environment
- Avid fishermen and boaters
- Seasonal residents
- Couples downsizing for financial freedom
- Weekend anglers needing a home base
